definition: a young man, said in a friendly way
description: An old stone harbour wall on a grey, windy day. A grinning young lad in navy swim shorts leaps off the edge of the wall into the air, arms out and legs bent, falls straight down and lands in the choppy green water with a big splash. He comes up, laughs and raises one arm. On the wall above, three other young lads in swim shorts watch and cheer, one holding his head in his hands, one holding up a bag of crisps. A football and trainers lie on the mossy stone steps, a rusty ladder runs down the wall and small fishing boats float in the harbour.

en.question: Where is the lad leaping from?

es.answer: Está saltando desde el muro del puerto.
